tools.name: file_new
tools.description: New. Replace the document with an empty net.

tools.name: file_export_json
tools.description: Export JSON. The document as pflow.xyz JSON-LD (unbounded capacities as null).

tools.name: file_cid
tools.description: Compute CID. The CID the document seals to (the same as /api/save and pflow-native file.cid).

tools.name: edit_undo
tools.description: Undo. Undo the last edit.

tools.name: edit_redo
tools.description: Redo. Redo the last undone edit.

tools.name: edit_delete
tools.description: Delete. Delete places and transitions, with every arc that touches them.

tools.name: net_info
tools.description: Net info. Counts, ids, labels and rates: a summary of the net.

tools.name: net_add_place
tools.description: Add place. Add a place at (x, y).

id.description: id (default: the first free p0, p1, …)

tools.name: net_add_transition
tools.description: Add transition. Add a transition at (x, y).

id.description: id (default: the first free t0, t1, …)

tools.name: net_add_arc
tools.description: Add arc. Add an arc between a place and a transition. inhibit on place→transition is an inhibitor arc; on transition→place it is a read arc (the editor's output-side inhibit).

tools.name: net_set_arc
tools.description: Set arc. Change an arc's weight or whether it inhibits.

tools.name: net_delete_arc
tools.description: Delete arc. Delete the arc(s) from source to target.

tools.name: net_set_place
tools.description: Set place. Set a place's initial marking and/or capacity (0 or null = unbounded). An initial marking over capacity is refused, not clamped.

tools.name: net_set_label
tools.description: Set label. Set a node's label (≤ 100 characters, one line).

tools.name: net_add_tokens
tools.description: Add tokens. Add (or with a negative delta, remove) tokens of one color. Refused below zero or over capacity.

tools.name: net_move
tools.description: Move node. Move a node to (x, y).

tools.name: net_rename
tools.description: Rename node. Change a node's id, updating every arc.

tools.name: net_set_details
tools.description: Edit details. Set the net's name and description (an empty string removes one).

tools.name: sim_enabled
tools.description: Enabled transitions. The transitions enabled at the current marking.

tools.name: sim_marking
tools.description: Marking. The current marking, per place, per color.

tools.name: sim_fire
tools.description: Fire. Fire one transition (the token game). Refused when it is not enabled.

tools.name: sim_reset
tools.description: Reset marking. Back to the marking the run started from.

tools.name: sim_set_rate
tools.description: Set rate. Set a transition's rate (≥ 0; 0 disables it in the ODE). Rates are part of the document.

tools.name: sim_ode
tools.description: Run ODE. Integrate the mass-action ODE from the current marking (Tsit5, the document's rates) and store a time-series artifact. The result carries initial, final and delta per place.

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: opt_rate_scan
tools.description: Rate scan. Sweep one transition's rate and record each place's value at t_end (the editor's steady-state reading, not a detected equilibrium). Stores a time-series artifact whose x axis is the rate.

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: opt_sweep
tools.description: Sweep. One place's trajectory for each of several rates of one transition, resampled onto one time grid. Stores a time-series artifact with one series per rate (group k=<rate>).

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: sim_ssa
tools.description: Run SSA. Gillespie stochastic simulation from the current marking with the document's rates (petri-ssa.js: go-pflow's portable SSA, byte-exact with pflow-native's sim.ssa on the same seed). runs > 1 averages realizations and stores the mean with a ±1 sd band. Exact for small token counts and for nets the ODE cannot read (inhibitor or read arcs, capacities).

seed.description: RNG seed (default 1); realization r uses seed + r

tools.name: sim_sde
tools.description: Run SDE. Chemical Langevin SDE (petri-sde.js) from the current marking: continuous with intrinsic noise, cheap at large populations. Same output shape as sim.ssa. Refuses nets with inhibitor or read arcs or reachable capacities, which a diffusion cannot express (use sim.ssa).

seed.description: RNG seed (default 1); realization r uses seed + r

tools.name: sim_what_if
tools.description: What if one more. The same seeded stochastic runs with and without delta more tokens in one place (sim.compare on one shared seed): an overlay of both and a table of final means. The shared seed makes the difference measure the change, not the dice.

place.description: the place that gets more tokens

delta.description: tokens to add (default 1; may be negative)

tools.name: sim_recommend
tools.description: Which engine?. Which engine to run this net with, and why (docs/engine-selection.md): constraints the ODE cannot see (inhibitor or read arcs, capacities) need the SSA; small token counts make the ODE's mean misleading and the SSA's spread matter; large unconstrained populations suit the ODE (and the SDE for noise). Also proposes a horizon, a seed and a run count.

tools.name: net_set_goals
tools.description: Set goals. Declare the net's reachability goals: markings it should be able to reach, e.g. [{"label": "everyone served", "to": {"served": 10}}]. "to" constrains only the places it names. The refinement gate (analysis.defects) counts a goal analysis.reach answers "no" to. An empty list removes them.

tools.name: net_set_views
tools.description: Set views. Declare the net's app screens (sim's Model.View): each a named projection, the places and transitions one screen presents, a role (board, dashboard, controls, advisor, trust, log), an optional title and prompt, and links to the views it navigates to. Every reference is checked; an empty list removes them.

views.description: [{id, role?, title?, prompt?, places?, transitions?, links?}]

tools.name: file_export_sim
tools.description: Export for sim.pflow.xyz. The net in sim.pflow.xyz's model shape (places with initial counts, transitions with rates, arcs as from/to with read and inhibitor types, labels as tags), ready for sim_create_model. Read arcs are written place → transition, as sim expects.

tools.name: analysis_roles
tools.description: Roles. What a console knows about the net before anyone runs it (sim's deriveRoles): pools an operator could add to, arrival sources, losses (patience), queues, terminal outcomes and services, and the disruptions those imply, grouped by the question they ask. The App view is built from this.

tools.name: analysis_behaviour
tools.description: Behaviour checks. sim's builder checks on the token game: parts of the net not connected to the rest, transitions that never fire, places nothing ever fills, a reachable marking where nothing can fire (with a trace), and a place growing past the token bound. One bounded exploration (max_states markings); when the bound is hit, claims needing the whole space are left out, not guessed.

unbounded_tokens.description: a place past this many tokens counts as unbounded (default 1000)

tools.name: analysis_defects
tools.description: Defect weight. sim's refinement gate, engine-computed: dead transitions + unmarked siphons (that can empty and stop transitions for good) + declared goals analysis.reach answers "no" to + conservation laws of a baseline that no longer hold. 0 is clean. Pass baseline_laws (P-invariant coefficient maps, e.g. from the net before an edit) to count lost laws; leave it out to count none.

max_states.description: budget for the exploration and each goal (default 2000)

tools.name: analysis_check
tools.description: Check net. The editor's strict check: every problem the editor would otherwise repair quietly, with a path, plus warnings. With engines (default true) and no errors, also runs the firing rule, the ODE solver's reading and CID sealing. Stores a report artifact.

strict.description: a key the editor does not write is an error (default false)

engines.description: run the engine checks too (default true)

tools.name: sim_goto
tools.description: Go to marking. Load a marking from a result onto the net: a step of a trace artifact (step), or a state of a graph artifact (node). The run baseline is kept, so Reset marking returns to where the run started.

node.description: graph node id (its data.marking is loaded)

tools.name: view_highlight
tools.description: Highlight nodes. Mark places/transitions on the canvas, optionally with a number badge each (e.g. invariant coefficients).

weights.description: {node: number} badges (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: view_clear_highlight
tools.description: Clear highlight. Remove the canvas highlight.

tools.name: artifact_show_set
tools.description: Show set. Highlight one node set of a sets artifact (an invariant's support, a siphon, an orbit) on the canvas; without a view, return it.

tools.name: artifact_list
tools.description: Results. The stored artifacts, newest last: id, title, kind and the command that made each.

tools.name: artifact_get
tools.description: Get result. One artifact in full.

tools.name: view_fit
tools.description: Fit to view. Frame the whole net.

tools.name: analysis_validate
tools.description: Validate. pflow-validation's structural checks (structure, connectivity, deadlocks, unboundedness, conservation) as a table, with a summary report. `reachability` also explores the state space (up to max_states).

reachability.description: also run a bounded reachability analysis (default false)

tools.name: analysis_incidence
tools.description: Incidence Matrix. The incidence matrix C = post − pre (rows: places in document order, `place.color` per used colour on a coloured net; columns: transitions). Read and inhibitor arcs move nothing, so they do not enter it. Returns pre and post too.

tools.name: analysis_invariants
tools.description: Invariants. Minimal semi-positive P-invariants (conservation laws, valued at the current marking) and T-invariants (firing counts that return the net to its marking), by Farkas elimination. Stores one node set per invariant (show one on the net) and the basis as a matrix; reports P-coverage (covered ⇒ structurally bounded) and T-coverage.

tools.name: analysis_siphons
tools.description: Siphons & Traps. Every minimal siphon and trap, from the arc structure alone (sim_invariants' siphon/trap report). Marks each siphon empty at the current marking (a deadlock witness: the transitions needing it never fire again) and whether it contains a marked trap (Commoner's property, which certifies deadlock freedom for ordinary nets and liveness for free-choice ones). Refuses nets over 128 token places or a search over budget.

tools.name: analysis_verify
tools.description: Verify Properties. Check properties (sim_verify's JSON): deadlock-free, bounded (with bound k > 0: every place ≤ k), live, terminating, reachable/unreachable {target}, invariant {expr}, mutual-exclusion {places, bound}, conserves. Each verdict is proved / refuted / unknown with its method (structural holds for any initial marking; exhaustive for this one; partial = truncated). Every refutation with a replayable counterexample stores a trace.

properties.description: array of properties (or a JSON string of one); default bounded + deadlock-free (pass a JSON value as a string)

from_current.description: verify from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_reach
tools.description: Reach Marking. Is `to` reachable (sim_reach)? `to` constrains only the places it names, each to exactly that count. yes: a shortest firing sequence, stored as a trace; no: a P-invariant whose weighted sum separates from and to (valid whatever inhibitors, read arcs or capacities allow), or an exhaustive search; unknown: the budget ran out (not a no).

to.description: {place: n} or {place: [per color]} (null entries free); place.color names one color (pass a JSON value as a string)

from.description: sparse override on the start marking, same shape as to (pass a JSON value as a string)

from_current.description: start from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_reachability
tools.description: Reachability Graph. Explore every marking reachable from the initial (or current) marking under the token game's firing rule. When a marking strictly covers an ancestor through a pump of monotone transitions, the places that grew become ω (Karp–Miller coverability), so an unbounded net still gives a finite graph. Stores a graph (node per marking, edge per firing) and a report.

max_states.description: markings to keep, 1..20000 (default 2000); beyond it the graph is truncated

from_current.description: start from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_canonical
tools.description: Canonical Id & Orbits. An isomorphism-invariant id (equal for two nets that differ only by renaming) and the exact automorphism orbits, by individualization-refinement (a port of sim_canonical). One node set per non-trivial orbit. Refuses past a 1,000,000-step budget.

tools.name: analysis_classify
tools.description: Classify. Classes of nodes the net cannot tell apart, by colour refinement (a port of sim_classify without its sampled experiments): quantitative colour → FungibleSet candidates, settled by the exact orbits when verify is on; structural colour → Roles. One node set per class.

scope.description: "all" (places and transitions, default), "places", "transitions" or "pools" (sim's: conserved/bounded places marked initially)

verify.description: settle fungible candidates by the exact orbit search (default true)

tools.name: sim_equilibrium
tools.description: Find Equilibrium. Integrate the ODE from the current marking and rates until pflow-solver's equilibrium detector fires (|du/dt| below tolerance) or t_max runs out; stores a report.

method.description: tsit5 (default), rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32

tools.name: sim_scenario
tools.description: Run Scenario. A sim_scenario what-if from the current marking: {name, marking, rates, schedule, hours, samples, realizations, seed, summary, engine: ssa|ode}. Stores a mean±sd time series and a per-place finals table; returns finals, metrics, depletion and contention. Unknown fields are refused.

scenario.description: scenario object (or a string holding one), e.g. {"hours":8,"realizations":16,"marking":{"S":500},"rates":{"infect":0.002}} (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: sim_compare
tools.description: Compare Scenarios. Run several scenarios on one shared seed (sim_compare): an overlay time series (group = scenario) and a scenario × place table of final means.

scenarios.description: array (or a string holding one) of ≤ 20 scenarios, as sim.scenario takes; they must share hours and samples (pass a JSON value as a string)

seed.description: the shared seed (default: the first scenario's, else 20260809)

tools.name: sim_crosscheck
tools.description: Cross-check SSA / ODE / Invariants. sim_crosscheck: SSA ensemble mean against the mass-action ODE, and the net's P-invariants (Farkas) checked along both trajectories. Stores an overlay (group ssa/ode) and a report with per-place agreement and a verdict.

tools.name: analysis_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose (Influence). Which knobs move the outcome (sim_diagnose's influence reading, on the ODE): each transition's rate at rate·(1 ± delta), and +1 initial token on each place, against the observable's value at t_end. Stores a tornado chart ranked by |influence| and a report, with sim's SSA noise floor (spread across three seeds) when `noise` is on.

observable.description: place (display name, or base id summing colors); default: the sinks (produced, never consumed)

delta.description: relative rate perturbation in (0, 1] (default 0.5, sim's ×1.5 probe)

noise.description: estimate the SSA noise floor (default true)

from_current.description: start from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: opt_heatmap
tools.description: Parameter Heatmap. Vary two transitions' rates over a grid (≤ 40 × 40) and map the observable place's value at t_end (sim_param_heatmap). Uses coarser solver defaults (abstol 1e-4, dtmax t_end/20) since only the final state is read.

observable.description: place whose final value fills the grid (a base id sums its colors)

log.description: space both axes in log10 (needs positive bounds)

method.description: tsit5 (default), rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32

tools.name: opt_optimize
tools.description: Optimize (Pareto). Monte Carlo over transition rates (seeded): one ODE run per sample, objectives read at t_end, non-dominated samples flagged (sim_optimize). Stores a scatter (Pareto highlighted) and a table of every sample.

parameters.description: [{transition, min, max, log?}] (or sim's {transition: [min, max]}) (pass a JSON value as a string)

objectives.description: [{place, sense: "max"|"min"}] (`direction` is accepted for sense) (pass a JSON value as a string)

method.description: tsit5 (default), rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32

tools.name: compose_components
tools.description: Components. The component library: sim.pflow.xyz's registry (arrivals, service, hazard, inventory, decision, mailbox, datastore) and pflow-compose's templates (sir, seir, queue, producer-consumer, workflow) and subnets (bounded-queue, resource-pool), each with its ports (role: in/out/inout/observe), params with defaults, and discipline notes.

tools.name: compose_fuse
tools.description: Fuse Component…. Instantiate a library component into the open net (sim_compose): its nodes are renamed <prefix>_<id> and placed at (x, y) (default: right of the net), and each port in `attach` is fused onto an existing place (the shared place replaces the component's copy). Declared rates become session rates. On a net with several token colors, `color` picks the one the component's tokens and weights use. One undo step.

attach.description: {port: existing place id} fusions (pass a JSON value as a string)

params.description: {param: number} overrides of the defaults (pass a JSON value as a string)

prefix.description: instance prefix for created ids (default: the component name)

x.description: left of the placed component (default: right of the net)

y.description: top of the placed component (default: the net's top)

color.description: token color (index or name) on a multi-color net (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: compose_extend
tools.description: Extend (Edit Ops)…. Apply sim_extend's structural edit ops to the open net, each as the matching registry command, all as one undo step (any failure rolls everything back): add_place {id, initial, capacity, x, y, label}, add_transition {id, rate, x, y, label}, add_arc {from, to, weight, type: ""|inhibitor|read}, remove_place / remove_transition / remove {id} (arcs go too), remove_arc {from, to}, set_rate {id, rate}, set_initial {id, initial}, set_capacity {id, capacity}, set_arc {from, to, weight, type}, rename {id, new_id}, set_label {id, label}, move {id, x, y}. Returns the steps run and the before/after diff.

ops.description: array of {op, ...} objects (or a JSON string of one) (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: sim_run
tools.description: Run Random Steps. Fire up to `steps` randomly chosen enabled transitions (seeded, reproducible).

tools.name: sim_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate Moves. sim_evaluate (play method): fire each enabled move of a player and score the position it leaves by seeded rollouts — SSA over `horizon` (sim's engine), or random token-game playouts of at most `depth` firings. Stores a ranked table.

player.description: transition role, or transition-id prefix (e.g. "x"); default: every enabled transition

objective.description: linear objective to maximize, e.g. "win_x - win_o" or {"win_x": 1, "win_o": -1}; default win_<player> minus the other win_* places (pass a JSON value as a string)

horizon.description: SSA rollout horizon in model time (default 3, ≤ 10000)

depth.description: use token-game playouts of at most this many firings instead of SSA (≤ 10000)

tools.name: opt_fit
tools.description: Fit Rates to Data…. Fit transition rates so the mass-action ODE (from the current marking, over the data's time span) matches the observed series of a timeseries artifact (pflow-learn; pflow.xyz fitRates). Series are matched to places by display name (S, CoffeeBeans.brown), base place id or place label, or through `places`. Stores a report and an overlay (group "data" vs "fit"). `apply` sets the session rates (one undo step).

data.description: timeseries artifact id holding the observations

parameters.description: transitions whose rates are fitted (default: every transition with a positive rate)

method.description: nelder-mead (default, as pflow.xyz), coordinate-descent, adam, gradient-descent

space.description: log (default: fit ln(rate), steps are relative, rates stay positive) or linear (pflow.xyz)

places.description: {series name: place} when series names are not place names (pass a JSON value as a string)

group.description: fit only series of this overlay group (default: ungrouped or "data")

apply.description: set the fitted rates as session rates (default false; one undo step)

solver.description: ODE method: tsit5 (default), rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32

tools.name: opt_distill
tools.description: Distill Search into Play…. sim_distill: fit rate multipliers for transition groups so sim.evaluate's play scorer (seeded SSA rollouts) ranks moves as exact minimax does, on positions from seeded random self-play. The game is read from places named <player>_turn (moves consume the turn token and pass the turn), or from `players`. Reports agreement before/after; stores a report and a per-position table. `apply` sets the multiplied rates (one undo step).

player.description: the player who maximizes the objective (default: the one to move now)

players.description: {name: {turn, transitions?, maximizes?}} instead of the <name>_turn inference (pass a JSON value as a string)

objective.description: linear objective, e.g. "win_x - win_o" (default win_<player> minus the other win_* places) (pass a JSON value as a string)

groups.description: {group: [transition ids]} sharing one multiplier (≤ 16; default: moves and house) (pass a JSON value as a string)

apply.description: multiply the groups' session rates by the fit (default false; one undo step)

tools.name: file_examples
tools.description: List Examples. Names of the bundled example nets.

tools.name: file_open_example
tools.description: Open Example. Load a bundled example net.

tools.name: file_seal
tools.description: Seal (Set @id to CID). Compute the CID and store it as the document's top-level @id, as pflow.xyz does. Idempotent; undoable.

tools.name: net_layout
tools.description: Auto Layout. Rearrange every place and transition with one of pflow.xyz's layout algorithms, as one undo step, then fit the view.

algorithm.description: sugiyama (layered, top to bottom), grid, bipartite (places left, transitions right), circular or string (pflow.xyz's string-diagram layout)

tools.name: net_set_colors
tools.description: Set Token Colors. Replace the token color list (`token[]`): names like "red", pflow.xyz token URLs or #rrggbb. Per-color vectors are kept by position, padded with 0 (weights with 1 for the first color) or truncated.

token.description: color names in order; [] = single uncolored token

tools.name: provenance_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify Receipt. Check a run receipt two ways, as sim's /api/receipts/verify: the Ed25519 signature against the key it embeds (trustedKey says whether that is this machine's key), and a replay of its certified scenario on the model it names (the open net, or a library model with that CID; also once their rates have changed, rebuilt under the receipt's modelRates), which must reproduce resultHash. A receipt without modelRates that was issued with session rates names the net under those rates; they are rebuilt from the rates its scenario ran with, unless the scenario overrode one, and then it is found only where they are again (set them back, or a library copy saved under them).

receipt.description: the receipt object (or the {result, receipt} sim.receipt returned, or a string holding either) (pass a JSON value as a string)

replay.description: re-run the scenario and compare result hashes (default true)

tools.name: provenance_check_witness
tools.description: Check Witness. Re-check a witness without searching (the local half of sim_check_witness): a trace artifact (analysis.reach / analysis.verify) or `trace` is replayed through the metamodel firing rule and every claimed marking compared; a reach answer (`reach`, or a reach report artifact) is checked as sim's reachcheck does (a yes trace replays from from and ends on to; a no certificate is a P-invariant, y·C = 0, that separates from and to); a `morphism` {definition or predicate, subject, object, map: {places, transitions}} is checked as an isomorphism (coloured-net-v1) or an induced embedding (induced-incidence-v1). Stores a report {verdict: valid | invalid | uncheckable, reason, failures}.

artifact.description: a trace artifact, or a report artifact holding a reach answer

trace.description: a trace: [{transition, marking}] (step 0 the start, transition ""), {steps: [...]}, or a list of transition ids from the initial marking (pass a JSON value as a string)

reach.description: a reach answer, exactly as analysis.reach returned it (pass a JSON value as a string)

morphism.description: {definition: coloured-net-v1 | induced-incidence-v1 (or predicate: isomorphicTo | subnetOf), subject, object (library model names, "current", or documents), map: {places, transitions}} (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: data_load_log
tools.description: Import Event Log…. Load a CSV or JSONL event log (from `path`, or inline `text`) as an event-log table artifact. Column/field names default to case_id, activity, timestamp, resource, lifecycle.

text.description: the log itself, instead of a path

format.description: csv or jsonl (default: from the extension, else csv)

tools.name: data_log_info
tools.description: Event Log Summary. Cases, events, activities, variants and timing of an event-log artifact.

tools.name: data_calibrate
tools.description: Calibrate Rates from Log…. sim_calibrate: learn per-transition rates from an event-log artifact. Every event is a firing; sources (no input place) get the case inter-arrival rate, others the rate of the gaps before their events (racing transitions split by completion share); session rate ≥ 100 = instant pickup, kept. Activities map to transitions by id, else by id or label ignoring case. Stores a rate-evidence table and a report (rates, unmapped activities, token-replay conformance). `apply` sets the session rates (one undo step; the result also lists the previous rates and the sim.set_rate steps that restore them).

log.description: event-log artifact id (data.load_log, or a table with case/activity/time columns)

unit.description: model time unit the rates are per: hour (default, as sim), min, s, ms, day

apply.description: set the learned rates as session rates (default false; one undo step)

conformance.description: replay the log for fitness/precision (default true)

tools.name: data_conformance
tools.description: Check Conformance…. Token-replay conformance of an event-log artifact against the current net (sim_conformance): fitness, precision (ETC), generalization, simplicity, a residual block, and per-variant diagnostics. Each case replays from the initial marking; activities match transitions by id, then label, then either ignoring case. Stores a report, a per-variant table and a sets artifact of the places and transitions where tokens were missing or left over (show one on the net with artifact.show_set).

max_traces.description: replay only the first N cases, in case-id order (≤ 100000)

tools.name: data_replay
tools.description: Replay Event Stream…. Online conformance (sim_conformance_stream): replay an ordered event stream — a log artifact in row order, or inline `events` [{case, activity, timestamp?}] — case by case from the initial marking, force-firing divergent events so cases resynchronise. Reports the first divergence (blocking places, marking, the shortest repair of unobserved transitions) and stores a running-fitness time series (x = event index) and the replay of one case as a trace (step 0 = initial marking; sim.goto replays it): `case`, else the first divergent case, else the first case.

log.description: event-log artifact id; rows are taken in table order

events.description: [{"case": .., "activity": .., "timestamp": ..}] in stream order (or a string holding it) (pass a JSON value as a string)

case.description: replay only this case (and trace it)

repair_depth.description: most unobserved transitions a repair may use (default 4, ≤ 64; ≤ 0 turns repair off)

tools.name: data_generate
tools.description: Generate Event Log…. A synthetic event log from the current net (sim_dataset): `cases` seeded SSA playouts from the initial marking, each until deadlock or `max_steps` firings; one event per firing (activity = transition id). Time starts at 2026-01-05T08:00:00Z (sim's epoch), one model time unit = one hour, each case starting where the previous ended. Deterministic for a seed. Stores an event-log table (export.artifact as CSV; feeds data.conformance and data.discover).

seed.description: RNG seed (default 1); case k uses seed + k - 1

rates.description: {transition: rate} over the session rates (0 disables) (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: data_discover
tools.description: Discover Net from Log…. Process discovery with pflow-mining: REPLACES the current net with the mined one (one undo step restores it), laid out with Sugiyama. method: alpha (≤ 12 activities), heuristic (threshold = dependency threshold, default 0.5), sequential or common-path. Returns the net's size and the log's conformance against it; the log artifact is kept (under a new id, returned as `log`).

tools.name: model_list
tools.description: List Models. Names in the model library with their sizes.

tools.name: model_get
tools.description: Get Model. A library model (or "current") as pflow.xyz JSON-LD.

tools.name: model_open
tools.description: Open from Library…. Make a library model the open net (undoable; the previous net is not saved to the library).

tools.name: compose_diff
tools.description: Diff Models…. Structural diff of two models (sim_diff): library names or "current". Stores a table (kind, id, change, before, after), a summary report, a side-by-side drawing, and, when one side is the open net, node sets (added / removed / changed) to highlight on the canvas.

tools.name: system_ports
tools.description: List Ports. Declared ports of a model, or (no model) of the open net and every library model that declares any.

tools.name: system_binding
tools.description: Get Binding. A binding by id with its check computed now (sim_get_binding): ok (with the unit verdict), refused (a model changed since it was bound) or uncheckable (a model it names is gone).

tools.name: system_bindings
tools.description: List Bindings. Every binding (or those touching `model`), with its check verdict now.

model.description: only bindings from or to this model

tools.name: system_show
tools.description: Show System…. A stored system's view, computed now (sim_system {id}): each model (present or missing) with its ports, each binding with its check, whether the set runs as a pipeline (order, loops, maxHours), and for every port what is bound to it and what else in the system could be. Stores a Graph and a Report.

tools.name: system_list
tools.description: List Systems. Stored systems with their models and bindings.

tools.name: system_run
tools.description: Run Pipeline…. Run a system (or a list of bindings) as a pipeline (sim_run_pipeline): every model runs as itself in topological order, each binding's source place trajectory resampled into the target transition's rate schedule (× transform × conversion, shifted by its delay); a loop through a delayed binding is solved by sweeps to its fixed point. Stores a TimeSeries overlay (group = model), a Report (order, loop verdict, per-binding flows, assumptions) and, with graph: true, an annotated Graph.

bindings.description: binding ids to run instead of a system

engine.description: ode (default: mass-action ODE, deterministic) or ssa (sim's scenario engine)

sweeps.description: most sweeps per loop (2..24; default: as many as the loop's delay guarantees)

tolerance.description: a loop also settles when its cut schedule moves by at most this (rate/h) between sweeps (default 0: exact fixed point)

graph.description: also store a Graph annotated with the run

tools.name: note_list
tools.description: Notes. Every note, oldest first, with its target; `orphaned` when its node or result is gone.

tools.name: macro_list
tools.description: List Macros. Macro names and step counts.

tools.name: macro_get
tools.description: Get Macro. A macro's steps.

tools.name: macro_play
tools.description: Play Macro. Replay a macro as one undo step (rolled back if any step fails).

tools.name: store_get
tools.description: Get Stored Model. A stored model's pflow.xyz JSON-LD (with @id = its CID).

tools.name: store_open
tools.description: Open from Store…. Make a stored model the open net (undoable; the net has no file path).

tools.name: store_list
tools.description: List Stored Models. Stored models, newest first, with title, size, created (ms), collections, license and successor. `query` filters by title or CID substring. Stores a table artifact.

query.description: case-insensitive substring of the title or CID

tools.name: store_edges
tools.description: Edges. Every relation touching an entity, as subject or object, ordered by time. Stores a table artifact.

tools.name: store_neighbors
tools.description: Neighbors. One hop from an entity through the registry (sim_neighbors): no predicate = objects of its outgoing edges; an inverse name (narrower) reads its stored predicate backwards; a symmetric one counts both ways. direction: out (default), in, both.

tools.name: store_query
tools.description: Query Graph…. Conjunctive pattern query over the edges (sim_query): {select, where: [{subject, predicate, object, mode: edge|path|closure, maxHops}]}, ?name for variables; no variables = a yes/no question. Stores table and graph artifacts.

pattern.description: the query: {select?, where}, a pattern list, or its JSON text (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: store_collection_list
tools.description: List Collections. Collections with their member counts. Stores a table artifact.

tools.name: store_migration_offers
tools.description: Migration Offers. What supersession does to each edge of a superseded model: taxonomic edges are offered for the current successor (with the link check on the proposed edge); tool-written and structural edges stay. Stores a table artifact.

tools.name: store_map_get
tools.description: Get Table. A stored table's data by id.

tools.name: store_map_list
tools.description: List Tables. The id and key count of every stored table. Stores a table artifact.

tools.name: store_graph
tools.description: Knowledge Graph. The store as a graph: models, collections and the edges between them (plus provenance parents). `around` limits it to `depth` hops (default 2) of one entity.

around.description: entity id (or collection name) to centre on

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Store Info. Where the store lives, what it holds, and the predicate registry.

tools.name: game_value
tools.description: Game Value…. The exact value of the current position, from the +1 side's view, with both sides playing perfectly: pflow-metamodel's alpha-beta search over the firing rule, run as `plan` names it. The game is the net read through `sides` (who owns each transition), `reward` (read off the final marking) and `auto` (transitions nobody chooses, fired first). The value is null when the search runs past its node budget (`nodes` then reports the budget). A plan and budget give the same result on every machine, except with the "ode" root estimate: it solves the mass-action ODE with every transition at rate 1, not the session's rates, and its step control uses the platform's floating-point `powf`, so the native and browser builds can search different numbers of nodes, and near the budget one can finish where the other does not. Changes neither the net nor the marking; the result is stored as a Report.

sides.description: {transition-id prefix: sign}: who moves, e.g. {"x_": 1, "o_": -1} (+1 maximizes the reward) (pass a JSON value as a string)

reward.description: {place: weight} read from the final marking, from the +1 side's view, e.g. {"win_x": 1, "win_o": -1} (pass a JSON value as a string)

auto.description: transition-id prefixes that fire as soon as they are enabled, before anyone chooses (e.g. ["x_win_", "o_win_"]: win claims)

plan.description: a SearchPlan (pflow-metamodel), or a JSON string of one: {mode, order, filters, root, drivers, memo}; default {}. A time budget (budget.ms) is refused. Root estimate "ode" solves the mass-action ODE with every transition at rate 1, not the session's rates (pass a JSON value as a string)

nodes.description: the node budget when the plan's drivers set none (default 1,000,000; at most 100,000,000)

book.description: an opening book: the text of a label cache as the experimental rnn commands write it to `labels` (JSONL, a header line naming the net and rules, then one position per line); its positions are pinned in the table, exact

tools.name: game_move
tools.description: Best Move…. A best move at the current position and its exact value (pflow-metamodel's Solver::choose, run as `plan` names it; the game as for game.value). It is a best move: another plan may pick another, equally good one. Past the node budget there is no move (transition null, reason "past the budget"), unless the plan's mode is "play", where the move is a guess (exact false): the table's best move at the position if it has one, else the first the plan's root pieces rank, which is the net's first enabled move when the root names none, so give a root order (e.g. ["ode"]) for a guess worth playing. Deterministic as game.value is: the "ode" estimate runs every transition at rate 1, not the session's rates, and can search a different number of nodes in the browser build than natively. The move is not fired: sim.fire it. The result is stored as a Report.
